A LETTER FROM ASJAD

My Ashka,

One year.

I don't think a calendar can really explain what that means to me. It isn't just 365 days. It's every conversation, every laugh, every little disagreement, every quiet moment, and every time I've looked at you and thought, “Yeah… it's her.”

I still love your eyes. I still love your smile. And I still love the little world we've created in between all the ordinary days. Even your Angry Bird moments have become memories I wouldn't trade.

Kattachi. Mah. Pattu. Whatever I call you, the feeling underneath it is the same: you matter to me more than I know how to say.

I can't promise that every day ahead will be perfect. Life will have ups and downs. We'll have days when we're happy, days when we're stubborn, and days when we need each other a little more. But I can promise you this: I want to be there.

I want to marry you. I want to grow with you. I want to laugh with you, fight with you, make up with you, build a home with you, and keep choosing you through every version of life.

Happy first anniversary, my love. Thank you for becoming one of the most beautiful parts of my life.

Forever yours,
Asjad ♥
